reviews.text: Friendly and helpful
Always stocked, fairly priced, cute kitties, and staff who are kind and happy to help. 💖 …

Cute shop. Seemed like a lot of options for supplies, food, toys, etc. for such a small space. It had the exact kind of charm one would expect from a local pet store.
Odd experience with the employees though. There is a look out there that rivals the gen Z stare, and I was subject to it today when I greeted the person at the front.
Cute area, easy transaction, slightly overpriced but it's what I paid for convenience. Overall not a great first impression but what can ya do.

They was the best very informative they are so helpful. The hostess was the best she was with me the whole time and answer all the questions I had I will always return there..   im forever a customer.
Great selection of cat devices
Incredibly kind and helpful people! I needed a harness for my dog, and they found the perfect size/kind for him. They helped me fit it and everything!

Baltimore Pet Shoppe is awesome! They have a surprising amount of pet supplies for a small space. Staff are super helpful and even helped get harnesses onto our wriggly puppy to figure out what size he needed. Love to support local businesses like this one and highly recommend for other pet owners. As a bonus, they have cute cats walking around the store!
Wonderful local pet shop great customer service always helpful and welcoming
they have two shop cats that live there - so cute and friendly! they have everything I need for my pet - shop local!
Great local pet store! Super helpful and friendly staff, very competitive prices (really comparable with online/big box retailers), so glad it's in the neighborhood!
Good selection, friendly staff, local business. The managers, Dawson and Sprout, seem to hang around doing nothing, but they are very cute, and worth the visit alone.

Great selection and helpful staff. I used to assistant manage a pet valu so I have some knowledge in this realm and thai place has really fantastic, high quality options in terms of food, treats and toys for dogs and cats. They have a wide variety of quality products at multiple price points. I definitely will return and buy more

My one gripe: although I would.
Rate the staff as overall  friendly and helpful they were not initially very polite or welcoming. When i first walked in with my dog I noticed they cat roaming free around the store  I  wasn't sure how my dog would react to the cat so I kind of asked what I should do or if they could contain the cat. I expected this request to be seen as sensible and reasonable ( believe me.I have nothing against cats.I love cats , but I just didn't know how my dog would react to the cat. Obviously i just wanted to avoid any issue)  But instead of understanding this, They can kind looked me like I was a weirdo or high maintenance or something, or as though I was the first ever dog owning customer to be tentative around the cat while my dog was with me. Basically, I was just unsure what to do.My dog was with me.He's never been around a cat, so I wasn't sure how he would react.I didn't want my dog to chase the cat.So I asked if they could put the cat away essentially , and they made it seem like-- or at least in the moment they made it seem like i was inconveniencing them or making a ridiculous request.
Very helpful staff and well-stocked store
So helpful! Special needs elder kitty knowledge was outstanding. Thank you, crew!
I love this pet shop, I found good this for my dogs
Small store with very helpful and friendly staff...great selection for such a small store
Great local pet store, employees are friendly and helpful.

This store has become my all time favorite pet store. They are always so helpful and if they don't have something I am looking for they're really great at offering alternatives or even special order if needed. Truly can't recommend this place enough. Also, it seems every one of the staff are experts and they also have a wealth of information resources to point you to for any questions about cat care.
The employees are helpful and they also have some cheap pet supplies.. lil cool shop
Nice shop with quality supplies but the one of the main people there can be consistently condescending. Other staff are friendly though.
Very nice, knowledgeable, and helpful staff. They have everything we need for our fur babies. Offered support for my sick cat. Other customers were wonderful too.

Started shopping here recently instead of ordering my supplies online, and I am so thrilled to have this shop so local to me. They have a great selection of food, treats, and supplies for my cat, as well as some supplies for my snake (the reptile selection isn’t as vast as their others, however they carry the majority of basics that I need, even frozen mice at reasonable prices (it’s a smaller, locally owned store, and reptile keeping varies so drastically that finding supplies is more of a specialty, so I have no qualms there.) I’ve been in several times now and truly love the staff here, theyre kind and welcoming and offer fantastic recommendations. i love this place and will continue to be a regular here. the shop cats are also a huge plus, its always so sweet running into them while im shopping (or having sprout jump on a shoulder). thanks yall!!
I’d give a 5 if they spoke and helped first timers. Too busy in their own conversations
Helpful staff. Shop local!

Love this store. Awesome selection of food, treats, toys, and medical supplies, plus unique stuff you can't always find at other places (like the 2 adorable store cats). Their prices and quality of the inventory are better than what you'd get at a grocery store or a big pet store. The people who run the place are helpful and friendly. They always have what you need.
When I need to grab my pup some snacks, I come here. Little expensive. They should do like a rewards program. I’d visit more often if there was some type of deal in the mix. Dogs are expensive. lol

First time here, I was happily surprised to find a clean, organized, friendly shop with a healthy inventory of pet foods and accessories, toys, etc.  Though small, it is well-stocked and well-maintained.  The shop kitty is a perfect (no pun intended) host, and the staff was helpful and knowledgeable.

In a time when small businesses are fighting not to become a thing of the past, and there's a new big-box chain taking over every corner, the neighborhood store is an important part of city culture and history.

Whether you're walking or biking to a laundromat, coffee shop or deli, nail salon or barber, restaurant, grocery market, or pet supply, shopping local and shopping small businesses sustains and maintains neighborhoods and neighbors.

These merchants are an important part of any neighborhood:  the heartbeat.  Without them, the culture, the history, is obliterated by developers or left abandoned altogether.

I'm happy to support local small businesses, even when I'm an out-of-town visitor.  This pet supply shop is no exception - It's a gem!

The team here is helpful and kind! It's just about a one-stop shop when it comes to cat supplies, great selection if wet foods, treats, litter and toys. The prices are just about the same I used to pay at larger pet supply stores, except …
